tasks.title: Coordinate pending requests and receiving-agent delivery

Extend TaskUtils and TaskManager Jest tests with fake-timer, cross-action and same-conversation cross-task overlap, owner/non-owner cleanup, concurrency, valid/repeated/invalid feature-metric, and no-forward-on-invalid cases. It depends only on contract types so it can proceed independently of HTTP transport.
